caption: Steam from a kettle rises against a kitchen cabinet door, and the door beads with water that runs down.

sa.check: The steam rises against a cabinet door.
The water runs down the door.
The beads form where the steam meets the door.
The steaming comes first and the beading follows.

pc.expect: The steam rises to the door and the water on it runs downward in drips toward the counter.
pc.fail: A run travels up the door; or the steam sinks from the kettle to the counter; or water gathers along the door's top edge and stays; or a drip leaves the door and rises.

pc.expect: The beading only builds while the steam keeps arriving, and runs only advance downward.
pc.fail: The door dries while steam still plays on it; or the beads grow and shrink in turn; or the door is wet before any steam reaches it; or a run retreats up the door.

pc.expect: The water forms on the door where the steam reaches it and not on the hot kettle itself.
pc.fail: Beads form on the kettle's hot body while the door stays dry; or the door beads in a place the steam never reaches; or the steam plays on the door and it stays dry to the end of the clip; or the door beads evenly all over while the plume hits one spot.

pc.expect: The beads behave as water on a painted surface: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the door stays a rigid panel.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the door; or the door's paint bubbles and peels as the water runs; or the beads turn to frost on the warm door.

pc.expect: The door keeps its flat panel shape on its hinges and the kettle keeps its shape; nothing passes through either.
pc.fail: The door bends or bows; or a second door appears; or water passes through the door into the cabinet; or the kettle changes shape.

pc.expect: The door's colour and handle, the kettle and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The door changes colour; or the handle changes shape; or items on the counter rearrange.
